purpose: M7 gate: ingest holds the target channel count and sample rate with no dropped samples; recorded dataset replays with features equal to the CPU reference

machine.name: dell
machine.host: Dell PowerEdge R440, 2x Intel Xeon Silver 4214, Proxmox VE 9.2.21 (kernel 7.0.14-25-pve)
machine.guest: KVM guest, 24 vCPUs (2 sockets x 12 cores, 1 thread per core), 2 NUMA nodes (30372 MB and 31510 MB), host CPU type
machine.host_memory_per_node: CPU 1: 3x 32 GB DIMMs (96 GB); CPU 2: 2x 32 GB DIMMs (64 GB); DDR4-2400
machine.pinning: none for this run: both processes unpinned

network: loopback (127.0.0.1); sender and ingest on the same guest
storage: store on ext4 (relatime) on LVM on a QEMU virtual disk (write cache: write back), backed by a ZFS pool of 4x WD Blue SA510 SATA SSDs (no power-loss protection) behind a PERC H730P on the host; ZFS sync setting not checked from the guest
storage_probe: 1 MiB write + fsync, 40 runs: p50 84.9 ms, p90 104.8 ms, max 190.1 ms (python3 os.fsync loop, same filesystem, same day)
layout: default: channels 0-31 accelerometer at 25,600 Hz (16-bit), channels 32-63 strain gauge at 1,000 Hz (24-bit); 10 ms ticks; 851,200 samples/s
